versions.changelog:
Initial release of B2B Cold Email Coach.

- Diagnose and optimize cold email performance for B2B founders, SDRs, agencies, and freelancers.
- Covers 2026 deliverability standards: Google/Yahoo rules, DMARC/DKIM/SPF, domain setup, and warming best practices.
- Advises on targeting, offer, message, and infrastructure to boost open and reply rates.
- Provides clear guidance for email sequence design, personalization tactics, and list-building.
- Supports migration between top outbound tools and troubleshooting deliverability issues.
